d:
Govardhan puja par sabhi bhakton ko hardik shubhkamnaen
Govardhan puja vishesh | shri krishn bhajan sangrah | Govardhan Pooja Special | Shree Krishna Bhajans
Govardhan puja ke pavan avsar par bhagvan shrikrishn ki bhakti men lin ho jaeee | prastut hai shrikrishn ke madhur aur bhaktimay bhajnon ka vishesh sangraha.
Govardhan puja ka parv bhagvan shrikrishn dvara govardhan parvat dharan karne ki divy lila aur prakriti ke prati samman evan kritagyata ka sandesh deta hai.
